title: Settings
description: The settings that belong to your account.
section-account-description: Who you are here, and what you have connected to it.
section-privacy-description: What your account publishes about itself.
log-out-description: Ends this session on this device. Nothing is deleted.
could-not-save: Could not save that. Try again in a moment.
hide-loadouts-description: Takes your builds off your profile and off the tables that name players. They still count, anonymously, in each vehicle’s figures.
hide-battles-description: Only you see the Battles tab of your profile. Your battles still count in the site’s statistics, and the players you met still see you among their encounters.
section-billing-description: What you give to keep the site running, and where to change it.
billing-portal-failed: Could not open the billing portal. Try again in a moment.
billing-none: You do not support unicum.gg yet
billing-none-description: The site has no ads and is paid for by its players.
billing-total-description: Everything you have given, one-off gifts included. Thank you.
anonymous: Hide me on the supporters board
anonymous-description: Your name and your supporter badge stay off the public board and your profile.
